verdict.rationale: Sierra's own docs say the agent delivers real-time resolutions and completes tasks end-to-end, such as collecting payments over the phone with no IVR handoff. Its Insights product tracks case resolution as a metric distinct from engagement, and outcome-based pricing ties cost to achieved outcomes. One community comment says it handles processes that currently fall to human support teams. However, the pack gives no resolution rates or share figures, and nothing defines how resolution is distinguished from deflection or bounces. Missing for 10: quantified end-to-end resolution rates, a documented definition separating resolution from deflection, independent corroboration of the share of conversations resolved.

support.subject: As a support leader, the agent fully resolves a meaningful share of conversations end-to-end — measured as resolutions, not mere deflections or bounces

citations.quote: Track how your agent performs against your most critical metrics, like CSAT, case resolution, and more.
Collect card and ACH payments entirely over the phone with no IVR handoff.
you pay only when the software achieves specific, valuable outcomes: outcome-based pricing.
